headline: Pakistan's KSE-100 Rebounds on Selective Value Buying
summary: The Pakistan Stock Exchange snapped a two-day decline as selective value buying lifted the benchmark KSE-100 index into positive territory despite continuing domestic and regional political concerns.
why: The KSE-100 tracks Pakistan's primary equity market; equity valuations are closely monitored by frontier market funds and regional asset managers.

impacts.name: KSE 100
impacts.why: The benchmark index halted its two-session loss through value-focused equity accumulation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Selective buying attracted by lower equity valuations helped the benchmark KSE-100 rebound from previous sharp losses.
